purpose: Model-level recovery screening around the validated normalized pilot; not an experimental calibration or physical optimum

source_reference.title: Local validated reconstruction model
source_reference.source_locator: ModelParameters defaults and validated extended production grid

normalization.reference_frequency_source: dimensionless model time; explicitly not SI
normalization.angular_rate_convention: All entries are dimensionless ratios in the model normalization.
normalization.conversion: No SI conversion is authorized by this manifest.

objective.constraint_scope: normalized model only; no hardware constraint
objective.selection_note: A positive result is a model-level robust operating region only and must not be called physically optimal.

status_note: This manifest exists only to test whether the validated normalized model has a robust Pareto region. It must never populate physical_parameter_manifest.json.
